name: universal-ai-assurance-platform
description: One product, one repository, one desktop: a local-first, fail-closed AI software assurance platform (Quality + Security as domains over one shared core).

scripts.validate: npm run validate:policies && npm run validate:buildgraph && npm run validate:agents && npm run validate:knowledge && npm run validate:state
scripts.verify: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.desktop:dev: cd apps/desktop && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/desktop && npm install && npm run build
